items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] No, but I remember that bass player from there?

ctx.x: Yeah, and it was a Twin City. It was a big town. It was the Twin Cities. And they had a lot of music going there, and you could...and I just... I think Eddie Barefield played with Clarence Johnson. I got to talking with Eddie one day, boy, and...
Remember a fellow named Jack Oglesby? Remember him?
No, but I remember that bass player from there?
